# Vee: People Analytics AI Agent | Visier

People Analytics AI Agent
Vee: The AI agent that helps everyone make better people decisions
The AI agent for all people-related questions
Trusted by over 2 million users, Vee is the enterprise-ready people analytics agent that understands your workforce and delivers answers when and where they matter most. With Vee, you put the right insights in the right hands, instantly.
Vee
Vee is like a personalized analyst for every leader. It handles complex questions, improves over time, and adapts to the person asking. Built for accuracy, security, and scale, Vee helps your people analytics team extend its reach, so every workforce decision can be backed by data.
Vee Boards
Unleash Vee on your analyses. Vee Boards are AI-augmented insight boards that provide any leader with personalized guidance. They quickly illuminate what’s meaningful, so leaders can act with confidence.
Vee anywhere
Better people insights, wherever decisions happen
Vee works inside the tools your teams already use, making data-guided decisions part of everyday work—with less friction and more impact.
Vee for Microsoft Copilot
Bring people analytics into Microsoft Copilot to get instant answers without leaving your workflow.
- Ask workforce questions right inside Microsoft 365 tools like Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
- Get instant answers, charts, and summaries tailored to your document or task
- Run advanced analyses, like trends and correlations, using simple natural language prompts
Vee for Microsoft Teams
Chat with Vee in Microsoft Teams just like you would a colleague–in a browser, on a desktop app, or on a mobile device.
Vee for Slack
Ask Vee people questions right inside Slack and get instant answers, summaries, or charts without switching tools.
Vee within Visier
Start a conversation with Vee, or ask questions specific to a chart, a data point, or anything else you see within Visier.
Vee via your intranet or internal chatbot
Vee can complement your AI strategy by integrating with your intranet, internal chatbot, or other tools via API.
Visier MCP Server
Bundled with Vee, you can bring rich people insights into any AI agent with a single, governed connection—no custom integrations required.
- Connect AI agents like ChatGPT, Claude, Moveworks, or custom agents to Visier’s governed data model
- Deliver consistent, real-time answers across your AI workflows
- Scale AI with enterprise-grade governance and access permissions
See Vee in action!
Experience what Vee can do in our 3-minute guided product tour.
Three reasons why Vee changes everything
Transform your people analytics practice with generative AI
People insights for everyone
Vee blasts through the barriers between employees and the data they need. Anyone, regardless of data literacy, can get instant guidance in the moments that matter.
Deliver personalized analysis at scale
Vee can 10x the efficiency of your people analytics team. Let it automatically handle the vast majority of routine analytics, so your team can focus on high-value projects.
Security and privacy are built in
Vee is governed by Visier’s trusted enterprise security model. It respects the access level of the person asking, so you can introduce Vee with confidence.
Vee for everyone in your organization
Everyone from the C-suite to the individual contributor can benefit from instant insights about people.
Vee for CHROs
CHROs can ask any question about the entire workforce, so they can make data-backed decisions and deliver on the people strategy.
